project_name: 33/11 kV Industrial Receiving Substation & Technical Building EPC Package

sections.title: 33kV Underground Power Feeder Cables
sections.clause_text: All incoming 33kV main power feeders from the utility grid connection to the 33kV GIS switchgear incomer bays shall be 3-core 400 sq.mm annealed compacted Copper (Cu) conductor, cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) insulated, extruded semi-conducting screen, metallic screen, corrugated aluminium sheath, and extruded flame-retardant low-smoke zero-halogen (LSZH/FR) outer sheath rated 19/33(36) kV complying with IEC 60502-2. Aluminium conductors are strictly prohibited for primary 33kV grid feeders.

sections.title: 33kV Medium-Voltage Gas-Insulated Switchgear (GIS)
sections.clause_text: The 33kV indoor gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) assembly, including main busbars, vacuum circuit breakers, disconnectors, and earth switches, shall have a certified short-time symmetrical fault withstand rating of not less than 31.5 kA RMS for 3 seconds duration, with a peak withstand capability of 82 kA complying with IEC 62271-200. Internal arc classification shall be IAC AFLR 31.5 kA for 1 second.

sections.title: 15/20 MVA 33/11kV Power Transformers Neutral Earthing
sections.clause_text: Each 15/20 MVA 33/11kV power transformer shall have vector group Dyn11 with the 11kV secondary neutral brought out through a turret CT and connected to an outdoor Neutral Grounding Resistor (NGR) cubicle rated to limit single phase-to-ground fault current to 400 A for a duration of 10 seconds. NGR cubicle shall be IP55, stainless steel AISI 304, fitted with current transformer and neutral disconnect link.

sections.title: Numerical Protection Relays Communication Architecture
sections.clause_text: All feeder, transformer, busbar, and bay controller numerical relays shall support native IEC 61850 Edition 2 communications featuring dual optical Ethernet ports running Parallel Redundancy Protocol (PRP) in a zero-loss seamless fiber optic ring architecture directly to station SAS servers.

sections.title: Outdoor Cable Containment Ladder System
sections.clause_text: All outdoor cable containment ladders and structural supports between the transformer yard and the technical building shall be manufactured from marine-grade AISI SS316L stainless steel to resist ambient industrial salt-fog chemical corrosion.

sections.title: Main Substation Buried Earth Grid Conductor
sections.clause_text: The main perimeter and internal substation buried earth grid shall consist of 75 mm x 10 mm high-conductivity annealed tinned copper tape buried at 800 mm below finished grade, interconnected with exothermic welds complying with IEEE Std 80.
